weights: EMA weights, periodic checkpoint saved at the end of epoch 48 (save_every_epochs 4); this is M5 = E1 ep48 EMA
input_stack: [z-1 .. z+1] slices from <log>/img sorted by page index, clamped at the ends
prediction: soft-argmax of the pith heatmap channel, normalized (x, y) in [0, 1] with pixel centres at (i + 0.5) / W
rounding: x_px = rint(x * 778), y_px = rint(y * 778), clipped to [0, 777]; integer pixel index (Supervisely convention: column x, row y). Same rule as the log-10 evaluation of M5 (67-68% exact, 95% <= 1 px, mean 0.37-0.38 px).
null_pages: none: the model always predicts a point; it does not detect absence of pith
